items.raw_excerpt: Grímsey’s community comes to the big screen: Eyríki opens October 6 at Bíó Paradís, with English subtitles.
items.summary_en: A documentary about the island community of Grímsey opens on October 6 at Bíó Paradís in Reykjavík. The film is called Eyríki. It will be shown with English subtitles.

items.summary_en: Fourteen Brazilian states now have alcohol restrictions for drivers. Ceará state and four municipalities in Rondônia just adopted the Dry Law. The rules ban drinking before or while driving.

items.raw_excerpt: Hundreds of "Cockroach Party" protesters in India have taken to the streets, calling for one of the country's chief electoral commissioner to be impeached.
items.summary_en: Hundreds of protesters in India call themselves the Cockroach Party. They took to the streets and asked the country's chief electoral commissioner to resign. The group accuses the official of bias in running elections.

items.raw_excerpt: Housed in the Jumbo shopping centre, the library will cost the city nearly €600,000 a year in rent.
items.summary_en: A new library opened inside the Jumbo shopping centre in Vantaa, Finland. The space used to be a nightclub. The rent will cost the city close to 600,000 euros a year.

items.raw_excerpt: Sachin Kumar Yadav becomes KFON MD as the network reports 2,00,073 connections and a 34,505 km fibre footprint.
items.summary_en: Sachin Kumar Yadav has become the managing director of KFON. The network in Kerala now has 200,073 connections and 34,505 km of fibre lines.

items.raw_excerpt: A new gastronomic event has started in Lagos, bringing together 26 local restaurants throughout October, sharing dishes for groups of up to four people.
items.summary_en: A new food event has started in Lagos, Portugal. It runs through October with 26 local restaurants taking part. They will share dishes for groups of up to four people.

items.raw_excerpt: Irregularidades como propaganda eleitoral antecipada, compra de votos, uso da máquina pública, abuso de poder e uso indevido dos meios de comunicação podem ser encaminhadas pelo aplicativo.
items.summary_en: Brazil's election court says people can report vote buying, early campaign ads, and misuse of public resources through an app called Pardal. Reports about abuse of power and misuse of media can also be sent this way. The app gives citizens a simple way to flag election rule breaks.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 선거관리위원회(TSE)는 사전 선거 운동, 매수표, 공권력 남용, 방송 오남용 등의 선거 규정 위반을 Pardal 앱으로 신고할 수 있다고 밝혔습니다. 시민 누구나 앱을 통해 선거 부정 의심 사례를 쉽게 제보할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Brazil: Election complaints can be filed through the Pardal app

items.raw_excerpt: The Government of the Azores has made €2.8 million available to the Visit Azores Association to promote the Azores as a destination, according to an order published today in the Official Gazette.
items.summary_en: The government of the Azores has set aside 2.8 million euros to promote the islands as a travel destination. The money will go to the Visit Azores Association. The plan was published in the Official Gazette.

items.raw_excerpt: As ruas de Liceia, em Montemor-o-Velho, ganharam um colorido especial no domingo, 27 de setembro, com o regresso dos tradicionais…
items.summary_en: The streets of Liceia in Montemor-o-Velho turned colorful on Sunday, September 27. Villagers covered the roads with flowers for a tradition that is centuries old.

items.raw_excerpt: Rivers in the east of the Netherlands have fallen so low that the authorities can no longer measure whether ships can pass safely, leaving skippers to decide for themselves whether or not to sail and risk getting stranded. Rijkswaterstaat, the transport ministry department that manages the waterways, told broadcaster NOS its survey boats can no longer reach the shallowest stretches of the IJssel, the Nederrijn, the Pannerdensch Kanaal and much of the Waal. In certain places the channel is less..
items.summary_en: The rivers in eastern Netherlands are very low. Survey boats can no longer measure the water depth in several channels. Skippers must now decide on their own whether it is safe to sail.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 동부의 강 수위가 너무 낮아졌다. 관리 당국의 조사선이 여러 수로의 수심을 측정할 수 없게 되었다. 이제 선장들이 직접 항해 여부를 정하고 표류 위험을 감수해야 한다.

items.raw_excerpt: Oxford's Charlotte Nott says "so much" happened in the Big Brother house that could not be shown on TV.
items.summary_en: Charlotte Nott from Oxford says a lot happened in the Big Brother house that could not be shown on TV. She says everyone in the house was crying at some point.

items.raw_excerpt: Gluten-free diets have become more common across the world, but in the country known for its bread and pastries, finding 'sans gluten' options can still be a challenge in France - readers of The Local share their tips.
items.summary_en: More people around the world now eat gluten-free food. In France, it can still be hard to find gluten-free options, even in a country famous for bread and pastries. Readers of The Local share their tips.
items.summary_ko: 전 세계에서 글루텐 프리 식단을 따르는 사람이 늘고 있다. 빵과 페이스트리로 유명한 프랑스에서도 글루텐 프리 메뉴를 찾기는 여전히 쉽지 않다. 더 로컬의 독자들이 자신만의 요령을 전한다.

items.summary_en: Oslo has a fun surprise for art lovers and locals alike. The Norwegian capital hides its own version of the Mona Lisa. Visitors can go and see it for themselves.

The research, reported by local broadcaster AT5, came out this week at the same time as the city council and the shop’s owners faced off in court over the queue and how to deal with public nuisance caused by it. PhD researcher Rosa van...
items.summary_en: Homes near Fabel Friet, an Amsterdam chip shop, sell for less than similar homes just streets away. A TU Delft study says the shop's long TikTok-fueled queues weigh on nearby home prices. The city and the shop owners are now in court over the crowd and the nuisance it causes.
